financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of common stock (firm shares, excluding the underwriters' option); the filings do not state a closing date, so the date is that of the 8-K and final prospectus supplement
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us, will be approximately $93.6 million
